agent.problem: The wrong answer "Most of it" is a near-match to "All of it." Since David brought back everything, a baker could argue that he also brought back most of it.

rule.text: No near-matches. A wrong answer never means the same as the right answer, or close to it. If a baker could argue it's right, replace it.

agent.problem: The question depends on card 14 for essential context. "Those men" and "this" do not identify the men or their plan to withhold plunder from the two hundred who stayed behind.

rule.text: Always give context in the question. The story card before it isn't on screen anymore, so the question says who and what. Never "him," "that" or "it" pointing back to a card the baker can't see.

agent.problem: This non-opening story card has three sentences.

rule.text: Every other story card is 1 to 2 sentences.
